description: Start a generation. Charges the user's balance and returns a taskId at once; the result arrives later — poll get_task. A failed generation is refunded.

idempotencyKey.description: Repeat a call with the same key and the same request to get the same task instead of a second charge.

input.description: Model parameters, exactly as get_model lists them (camelCase). Media inputs are public URLs.

maxCostUsd.description: Refuse the request if it would cost more than this.

model.description: Model id from list_models, for example `veo3.1-fast`.

webhook.description: HTTPS URL to call when the generation completes.

name: create_generation
title: Create generation
